dogecoin.text:
Memecoins started as a joke.

But they’ve Survived through Narrative, Community, and Chaos.
And now, they’re experimenting with infrastructure.

From Dogecoin.
To @AraracoinX 
To @Mrpuggles 
They’re not just jokes anymore.

They’re the Punchline and the Blueprint.

2014 to 2017 the "Wait..is this thing real?" era

Dogecoin did things no one expected:
- Raised $30,000 to send the Jamaican bobsled team to the Olympics.
- Sponsored NASCAR driver Josh Wise.
- Became a tipping token on Twitter and Reddit

A joke was now funding real-world stuff.

Back in 2013, two software engineers were bored and unserious.

One worked at IBM.
The other, at Adobe.
They birthed a joke called Dogecoin, a parody of Bitcoin.

No whitepaper. No VC. Just… memes.
